title: THIRTY R8.2 consolidated issue register (post-R8.1 audits)

astra.note: Read verbatim, never edited. Untracked in the working tree.

claude.note: The complete Claude post-R8.1 report was not present anywhere in the workspace (repository, Desktop, Downloads, Documents, OneDrive searched by name and content). Its findings are registered from the founder directive's own description; their exact original wording, reproduction text and hash could not be preserved verbatim. FOUNDER ACTION: supply the report so it can be preserved under docs/audits/ and these entries checked against it.

deduplication: R81-A02 (Astra) and NEW-2 (Claude): one root cause — writers able to recreate Insight data derived from evidence being deleted — kept as one entry, tested by separate scenarios (assessment during Delete; queued payload landing after it; failed Delete then rollback; interrupted Delete; restarts).
R81-A08 (Astra) and Claude's I1/I2/I3 applied-marker retry observation: one root cause (no repair path after a target-success/marker-failure split), one entry.
R81-A03 (Astra) and NEW-1 (Claude) are related but distinct: kept as two entries, tested independently.

entries.title: A pending failed Pause bypasses the durable-credit prerequisite
entries.reproduction: Close saved, credit refused; next day, lapsed; Pause held; Free choice; Pause fails; restart twice: the earlier day's credit is gone.
entries.rootCause: CirclePlansNotifier.recordGuided judged 'nothing to credit' by the shown (optimistic) Plans; a pending Pause made the domain a no-op, accepted as durable completion by Today's pre-overwrite gate.
entries.fix: recordGuided distinguishes credited on disk / pending on screen / not owed on disk (legitimately unnecessary) / owed on disk but blocked by a pending change — the last waits for that change to settle (idle()) and re-evaluates; still blocked after 8 rounds it fails, so Today never writes over the session.

entries.title: Delete can finish successfully with recreated Insight metadata
entries.reproduction: Completed Plan cycle with review; Delete with the Plan evidence write held; Insights opened during it; release; restart: a Plan-review snapshot naming deleted Circles survives.
entries.rootCause: Insights assessed from Plans' confirmed snapshot, which kept the deleted evidence until the Plans write landed (and for ever if it failed); nothing stopped generation during a Delete; Plans/Insights failed saves could roll back onto pre-delete snapshots; Delete did not wait for saves queued meanwhile.
entries.fix: forgetStageEvidence/forgetAll remove the deleted data from the rollback/decision snapshot at once (and a pre-delete save landing later never restores it, by a deletion generation); assess() generates nothing while a Delete is under way or pending; Delete waits for Plans and Insights queues to settle and clears Insights again in its last pass; History's pending-write tracker is reset.

entries.title: Stage publication checks the live offer instead of the payload being saved
entries.reproduction: Earlier Today write held; Plan start held; stage choice; Kept Circle used today; Plan start refused; queued stage publication runs: stage Circle saved to the day keys with no durable served stage; survives restart.
entries.rootCause: _publish decided whether to await confirmServed from state.recommendation at write time, not from the Circle in the payload.
entries.fix: _publish gates on the stage of the payload it writes (or of the choice it carries); a stage Circle whose served stage can't be confirmed is never written and, if still on show (offered, started or closed), is taken back — today's choice opens again — so no unsaveable session runs.
entries.status: FIXED (working tree, uncommitted); supersedes the R8.1 accepted limitation 'pending-then-failed stage Circle stays on screen'

entries.title: An already-published stage Circle becomes unsaveable after legitimate Plan actions
entries.reproduction: Stage Circle published and started; Leave then Go through it again (lastServed replaced); Close and reflection are refused.
entries.rootCause: Every write of a shown stage Circle re-ran confirmServed against the Plan's mutable lastServed, and confirmStartNoted compared the Plan's current lastServed whatever Circle it named.
entries.fix: Publication is gated only when a write publishes a stage Circle (A03 fix); confirmStartNoted/noteStart settle that Circle's own served record only — a record no longer shown or stored is moot.

entries.title: I2 checks cycle A but applies gentler to pending cycle B
entries.reproduction: Leave held, Go through it again (visible cycle B); apply I2 for cycle A: B made gentler, Insight marked applied for A.
entries.rootCause: _gentler validated confirmedState but keepGentler ran on the optimistic state with no cycle identity.
entries.fix: apply() waits for pending Plans (and History) writes to settle before validating; keepGentler takes the Insight's cycleId and refuses any other cycle.

entries.title: Readable nested records still lose unknown or damaged fields
entries.reproduction: futureRule on an elementsLeftOut entry; unknown metadata on lastServed; object-valued fact / non-text evidence / unknown fields on an Insight snapshot — lost on an unrelated save. Malformed startedAfterExpiry coerced to false.
entries.rootCause: Accepted items were rebuilt from known fields; '== true' and string-coercing date parses read malformed values as defaults.
entries.fix: Suggestion-preference entries, ServedStageCircle and InsightSnapshot keep the stored map they were read from and write it back (only the fields THIRTY sets change); a present non-Boolean startedAfterExpiry/revisit/gentler or non-text drawsOn makes lastServed unreadable (kept as stored, credits nothing); preference dates must be text.

entries.title: Removing an overnight answer reopens finished reflection
entries.reproduction: Start 23:40, Close 00:10, answer; new day opens; remove the answer; restart 00:20: finished reflection reimposed, next choice blocked.
entries.rootCause: Completion was inferred only from the answers still retained.
entries.fix: Smallest backward-compatible durable marker: day key recommendation_reflection_finished (true once the reflection is answered as far as it goes), kept by answer removal, cleared by the next day's choice and by Delete; absent on older records, which read as before.

entries.title: Pending History cache state can create a durable Insight
entries.reproduction: I4 4/7 → 4/6: usefulness removed with the journal write held; Insights opened; write refused; restart: an I4 from unconfirmed History survives. Same boundary for Plan stage 5 answers (reproduced: stage 5 served from a removal later refused).
entries.rootCause: Insights and Plan stage answers read History from the SharedPreferences cache while its platform write was pending.
entries.fix: JournalWrites tracker (one per app) records History as last confirmed while a write is pending; readConfirmed() is what Insights, Plan stage answers and Insight application read; apply() waits for History writes to settle. No new persistence engine.

entries.title: I1–I3 cannot repair a failed applied marker after target success
entries.reproduction: Apply I1/I2/I3; target saved, marker refused; restart and retry: notAvailable, mark never recorded.
entries.rootCause: The status gate saw the Insight as no longer current (its change holds) and exited before any repair.
entries.fix: A stale, unmarked Insight whose own change is on disk — Plan made active by a cycle begun on or after the Insight's day, that very cycle made gentler then or later, that part left out then or later — is marked applied with the change's own date, without repeating the change. Premium check unchanged; I4 Keep rights unchanged.

entries.title: Wrong native preference types bypass unreadable-store recovery
entries.reproduction: An int/Boolean/list under circlePlansKey, insightsKey, suggestionPreferencesKey or circleJournalKey: provider initialization throws a cast error.
entries.fix: Every JSON-text user store, Today's pending-write record and the start-up deletion/retirement steps read with prefs.get and treat a non-text value as unreadable: Plans/Insights keep it aside with its native type before any overwrite; Preferences refuse changes until Reset; History keeps a JSON copy in its preserved list; a non-true deletion marker records no deletion.

entries.title: False notSaved when a later queued write already made the change durable
entries.reproduction: I2 apply: its Plans write refused, a later queued Plans write lands with gentler: reported notSaved, not marked.
entries.rootCause: confirmed() reported the outcome of the action's own earlier Future.
entries.fix: On failure confirmed() waits for queued saves and checks the confirmed final state holds every value the action changed (leaf-level diff); genuine failures stay notSaved.

entries.title: Regression report accepts missing or incomplete declared batch parts
entries.reproduction: R8.1 runner report on a copy of its own evidence with part 17c missing, replaced by a copy of 17b, or an undeclared 17f: EVIDENCE OK.
entries.rootCause: report counted whatever part summaries were present.
entries.fix: New R8.2 runner (R8.1 runner and evidence untouched): parts declared in the plan; report requires exactly the declared summaries, each with its own identity, command and file set, complete, plus per-case coverage.

entries.title: Offset-free historical timestamps
entries.status: ACCEPTED, unchanged. Boundary restated: the six-hour carry-over is exact only for UTC day-key instants written since R8.1; older offset-free day-key values stay ambiguous in the repeated hour. Lifted-rest comparison can be affected within that hour (not display-only).
